system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Tracker, Spy, or Detective.

[Boss], [Raid] appearing in the next scene, Set 1 enemy (selected by GM) to the [identified] state and get information. If there is no applicable enemy, the skill failed but does not count towards the limit. 

(Fumble): Enemy notices the scout.

A special skill that detects the presence of a formidable enemy before fighting and researches that information in advance. No enemy can escape your sight.
